name: Bank of Khazarad
desc1: This fair-sized building houses the wealthy bank of the dwarven king.
desc2: Heavily guarded and reinforced, it is as impregnable as the city
desc3: itself. A special courier system enables the agents of this bank to
desc4: communicate with the bank in Silvermere, allowing travelers to
desc5: withdraw or deposit in either bank to access an account.
